note: The inferred vibes from the Sound Palette page (https://claude.ai/artifact/T7VSxtbdugjktF5V1CFG5N). The operator edits vibes on that page; generate.py --vibes <file> takes an export of its saved edits, which win over these.

sounds.name: White
sounds.vibe: Radiant, orderly, holy. Bright bells over a clean major chord, a faint breath of choir, crisp and uplifting.

sounds.name: Blue
sounds.vibe: Arcane, fluid, cerebral. A glassy rising arpeggio with water droplets and a shimmering echo.

sounds.name: Black
sounds.vibe: Shadowy, hungry, sinister. A low beating drone, a slipping minor second and a breath that closes in.

sounds.name: Red
sounds.vibe: Explosive, impulsive. A fast fiery whoosh into crackling sparks with a hot distorted stab.

sounds.name: Green
sounds.vibe: Primal, growing. Deep wooden drum hits, rustling leaves and a low swelling horn.

sounds.name: Azorius
sounds.vibe: Law and order. A gavel knock and a precise crystal chime, measured and cold.

sounds.name: Dimir
sounds.vibe: Secrets and espionage. A muted pluck, a whisper that echoes and vanishes.

sounds.name: Rakdos
sounds.vibe: Demonic carnival. A detuned calliope wobble, a cackle-like flutter and a burst of fire.

sounds.name: Gruul
sounds.vibe: Savage. Stomping war drums and a guttural roar.

sounds.name: Selesnya
sounds.vibe: Harmony and community. A warm choir chord, rustling leaves and soft chimes.

sounds.name: Orzhov
sounds.vibe: Church and debt. A solemn pipe-organ minor chord with coins clinking.

sounds.name: Izzet
sounds.vibe: Mad science. Electric arcs, sparks and a rising synth zap.

sounds.name: Golgari
sounds.vibe: Rot and undergrowth. A damp squelch, insect clicks and a low earthy drone.

sounds.name: Boros
sounds.vibe: A legion at war. A brass fanfare and a metallic shield clang.

sounds.name: Simic
sounds.vibe: Mutation and biology. Bubbling, morphing pitch, liquid and alive.

sounds.name: Bant
sounds.vibe: Noble knights. A heraldic horn call over serene bells.

sounds.name: Esper
sounds.vibe: Etherium artifice. Glassy metallic chimes ticking like precise clockwork.

sounds.name: Grixis
sounds.vibe: Undead wasteland. An eerie low drone, a ghostly glide and embers crackling.

sounds.name: Jund
sounds.vibe: Dragons and predators. A deep roar, a burst of fire and heavy drums.

sounds.name: Naya
sounds.vibe: Giants in the jungle. Huge bright drums and a bold, sunny call.

sounds.name: Abzan
sounds.vibe: Endurance. A solid stone drum and a low, steady choir.

sounds.name: Jeskai
sounds.vibe: Monks and wind. A quick whoosh, wind chimes and a gong.

sounds.name: Sultai
sounds.vibe: Decadent necromancy. Dark water, a snake hiss and an ornate shimmer.

sounds.name: Mardu
sounds.vibe: A war horde at speed. A war horn over galloping drums.

sounds.name: Temur
sounds.vibe: Savagery and ice. An icy shimmer, a roar and crackling frost.

sounds.name: Four colours or more
sounds.vibe: Convergence. All five voices in a fast rising sweep that resolves into one bright chord.

sounds.name: Colourless
sounds.vibe: Metal and void. A mechanical clank over a deep alien hum.

sounds.name: Draw a card
sounds.when: A card moves from library to hand.
sounds.vibe: A quick paper slide, light and dry.

sounds.name: Shuffle
sounds.vibe: A short riffle of card edges.

sounds.name: Play a land
sounds.vibe: A soft, grounded thud.

sounds.name: Tap for mana
sounds.vibe: A small click with a tiny sparkle.

sounds.name: Spell resolves
sounds.when: The top of the stack resolves.
sounds.vibe: A short settling chime, falling to rest.

sounds.name: Spell countered
sounds.when: A spell leaves the stack without resolving.
sounds.vibe: A reversed, swallowed zap.

sounds.name: Declare attack
sounds.vibe: A blade swish and a low drum.

sounds.name: Block
sounds.vibe: A shield thunk.

sounds.name: Damage
sounds.when: Damage is dealt to a creature or player.
sounds.vibe: A dull impact with a crunch.

sounds.name: Gain life
sounds.vibe: A soft rising sparkle.

sounds.name: Creature dies
sounds.when: A creature goes to the graveyard.
sounds.vibe: A falling breath into a low thud.

sounds.name: Phase change
sounds.when: The game moves to the next step.
sounds.vibe: A barely-there tick.

sounds.name: Your turn
sounds.vibe: A two-note chime that says "you".

sounds.name: Victory
sounds.vibe: A short bright fanfare.

sounds.name: Defeat
sounds.vibe: A descending minor fall.
